draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Route Delhi to Ludhiana
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Route Delhi to Ludhiana

Dear Orion Pharma Team,

Following a mechanical breakdown of vehicle DL64IB1058, a replacement unit (HR73CY1771) has been dispatched from the Ambala hub.
The new vehicle is currently en route to complete the Delhi to Ludhiana delivery.
Please note the estimated arrival time is approximately 9.3 hours from now.
We apologize for the delay and will continue to monitor the shipment closely.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
